title: Codebook: Surveys
text:
The surveys in this codebook are named after the week in which they were collected: s00 represents the screening survey prior to the study and s01 to s21 represent the surveys during the 21 weeks of the study. The suffix indicates whether the questionnaire was completed on site in the laboratory (i.e., l) or online from home (i.e., o). For example, participants completed survey s08o online in Week 8.
The survey data are available as individual datasets in the ProPELL Data Hub. They can be joined as neccessary using the anonymous participant IDs.



The participant IDs in these datasets are anonymized, as the code generated by the participants during the study (e.g., IKTENT20) only allows for pseudonymized data.


Anonymized ID
The mapping of anonymous and pseudonymous IDs is available here (only authorized PIs; requires login).




Each variable has a prefix as part of its name. The prefix indicates whether a variable belongs to a screening (m0), pre-exercise (m1), post-exercise (m2), follow-up (m3), or weekly survey (w01 - w21). For example, m1_birthyear represents participant’s birthyear assessed in one of the pre-exercise surveys.

title: SPO-14582: Data Analysis
text:
Overview
“SPO-14582: Data Analysis” is a seminar offered in the M.Sc. Sport Science for Health at the University of Konstanz. It provides an introduction to data analysis using the statistical programming software R and the integrated development environment RStudio. The course is designed for students with little or no prior experience in programming and data analysis.
Overview of the course content:

Introduction to R and RStudio
Building blocks of the R language
Creating and working with objects in R
General workflow using R projects
Data merging, reshaping, and aggregation
Exploring and visualizing data
Analyzing data and testing hypotheses
